text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to an organisation. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding out what could go wrong, from financial problems to natural disasters. Once risks are known, mitigation strategies can reduce their impact or the likelihood of them happening. For example, a company might buy insurance or train staff to handle emergencies. In addition, contingency plans are important because they explain what to do if a risk actually occurs. Finally, monitoring is essential. Risks change over time, so regular reviews help businesses stay prepared and respond quickly to new threats. Good risk management protects both people and profits.
